description.en:
Restarts play, either with a kick-off or with another kind of restart, for a given team.

With only the team (or a second argument of 0), it sets up a kick-off by that team. After a scripted goal the story scripts give the kick-off to the team that conceded.
With a non-zero second argument it sets up a different restart, placed at the position given in the third argument. The values used by the scripts (1, 3 and 4) line up with the public restart constants RS_THROWING (1), RS_GOALKICK (3) and RS_DFREEKICK (4), which suggests that is what this value is.
The position is relative to the pitch: the engine multiplies X and Z by the pitch size factors and adds the pitch origin (Y is ignored).
Team that restarts: 0 = the player's team, 1 = the opponent team.
0 for a kick-off. Any other value sets up a different restart; the shipped scripts use 1, 3 and 4 (see the RS_* constants).
[x, y, z] in pitch-relative units, e.g. [0.8, 0.0, 0.6]. Defaults to the engine's default spot.

true once the restart is set up.
null if the match system is not ready or no argument was given.
